question: Raga Mala' is an autobiography of who among the following musicians?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ravi Shankar**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Raga Mala** is the title of Pandit Ravi Shankar's second autobiography.
 
• The book was published in **1997**.
 
• It offers an in-depth look into the maestro's life, covering his **musical journey, personal experiences, and collaborations** with various artists.
 
• The autobiography provides insights into **Indian classical music** and its evolution over the years.
 
• Notably, the book also discusses his **international collaborations**, especially with The Beatles' George Harrison.
 
• It includes a **foreword by George Harrison**, which adds a unique perspective to the narrative.
